Download NEI onroad emissions data

Source: R/source-nei.R
download_nei.Rd

Download onroad emissions CSV archives from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's National Emissions Inventory (NEI). Archives and extracted data are stored in separate subdirectories using the shared download workflow.

Usage

download_nei(
  year = c(2017L, 2020L),
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  unzip = TRUE,
  remove_zip = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  hash = FALSE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

year

integer(1 or more). Selected inventory years. Supported values are 2008, 2011, 2014, 2017, 2020, and 2023. Default is c(2017L, 2020L). Each value selects an individual inventory; c(2017, 2023) requests only those two years, without filling gaps. The download plan preserves the supplied order and repeated years. Unsupported years are omitted with a warning that lists the retained years. If no supported years remain, the function stops before creating directories or contacting the provider.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty parent directory. Archives are downloaded into zip_files/ and, when unzip = TRUE, extracted into separate per-archive directories under data_files/.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed. Downloaded archives and extracted CSV files can require substantial storage.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after directory creation, without contacting the provider. No archives are downloaded or extracted in preview mode. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. No command file is generated. Default is FALSE.

unzip

logical(1). Extract downloaded ZIP archives into per-archive directories under data_files/. Default is TRUE; FALSE skips extraction and creation of the per-archive directories.

remove_zip

logical(1). Remove downloaded archives and their zip_files/ directory, including remaining contents, after the extraction loop finishes. Default is FALSE. May be TRUE only when unzip = TRUE. No removal occurs when download = FALSE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show file download progress. Default is TRUE. Other status messages may still be printed when FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return a combined MD5 hash of the files under data_files/ instead of the download summary. Default is FALSE. Ignored when download = FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file download request, including the initial attempt. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative throttling interval in seconds, passed to download_run_method(). Default is 2.

Value

With download = FALSE, an invisible preview list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files. Otherwise, after downloading and optional extraction, hash = FALSE returns the download summary from download_run_method() invisibly. With hash = TRUE, returns a visible character scalar containing the combined MD5 hash of data_files/.

The download summary always contains success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no files failed, including when every file was skipped.

Details

A year-specific lookup selects the provider's archive path and filename. NEI releases use different version directories and naming conventions.

zip_files/ and data_files/ are sibling directories created beneath directory_to_save, including for previews and when unzip = FALSE. Each archive is extracted into a directory named after the archive with its .zip suffix removed. For example, the 2020 archive is saved as zip_files/2020nei_onroad_byregion.zip and extracted into data_files/2020nei_onroad_byregion/. This isolates duplicate filenames across inventories. Paths stored inside each archive are preserved.

Preview destinations refer to the archives in zip_files/, including files that already exist locally. For actual downloads, download_run_method() skips existing non-empty archives; they are still passed to extraction when unzip = TRUE. Preview mode makes no network requests. Individual download failures are recorded by the shared runner during file transfers.

Hashing covers all files recursively under data_files/, including the per-archive subdirectories and existing files, and excludes archives in zip_files/. With unzip = FALSE, hashing still uses data_files/, which may be empty or contain previously extracted data.

Download support covers more inventory years than process_nei(), which currently accepts only 2017 and 2020.

Note

NEI data does not require authentication.

References

United States Environmental Protection Agency (2024). “Air Emissions Inventories.” https://www.epa.gov/air-emissions-inventories.

See also

download_setup_dir(), download_unzip(), process_nei()

Author

Kyle Messier, Insang Song

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_nei(
  year = c(2017L, 2020L),
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "nei"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE,
  download = FALSE # Preview selected inventory URLs and archive paths.
)
} # }
